name: Mankitsu! ~Comic Café e Youkoso!~
original_name: まんきつ！～コミックカフェへようこそ！～
source:
The game is about running a manga café named "Orange Chiffon".
Your childhood friend's father went out for a long trip and left his only daughter, Yuu, as the manager substitute.
But because Yuu isn't good at managing the café, plus there aren't much customers coming to the café, you were asked by his father to help run the cafe instead.
Your goal in this game is make the manga café prosper.

[edited from a post on Akiba-Online]
translation:
本作讲述一家名为“Orange Chiffon”的漫画咖啡店的经营故事。
青梅竹马的父亲要长期外出，把独生女优留在店里担任代理经理。
然而，优不擅长经营，咖啡店的客人也寥寥无几，因此她父亲请你前来帮忙管理。
游戏目标是使这家漫画咖啡店生意兴隆。

[编辑自Akiba-Online的一篇帖子]
